title: Capacity Resonance Window and Scope Triage Scoreboard
creator: Priya Singh
description:
Problem: Mid-cycle surprises (urgent customer requests, infra incidents, regulatory asks) repeatedly cause churn in scope and opaque staff reallocations. We need an operational convention that makes staffing changes predictable, preserves a minimal float for emergent work, and provides a quantitative, repeatable scope-triage mechanism for PM/Eng tradeoffs.

Goal: Define and pilot a 'Capacity Resonance Window' — a rolling 10-working-day snapshot that: (1) reserves a calibrated surge buffer (default 10% FTE) for emergent critical-path items; (2) surfaces a Scope Triage Scoreboard to prioritize cuts/deferrals using consistent signals; (3) integrates with our cycle capacity tracker and the Console roadmap so PMs and Eng leads can make decisions with the same data.

Deliverables:
- Runbook (Confluence) describing cadence, decision owners, and escalation ladder.
- Scope Triage Scoreboard template: scoring heuristics and spreadsheet + automated feed into Console roadmap (priority, customer-impact, estimated dev days).
- Staffing ripcord policy: how to rotate staff from the float, how to call for surge, and limits on reassignments (max 2-week borrow without rebase).
- Dashboard panels (Grafana) showing rolling utilization, committed vs float capacity, pending emergency items, and projected carryover risk.
- Pilot across two initiatives (Optimize + Console UX) during 2026-W12/W13.

Acceptance criteria (high level):
- Scoreboard implemented and used in two weekly planning checkpoints during pilot.
- Dashboards show rolling utilization and float; alerts when float < 6% for two consecutive days.
- At least one mid-cycle surge handled via the ripcord process with documented decision and minimal cross-team burnout feedback.
acceptance_criteria: Scoreboard adopted by two initiative PMs and used in 3 decision checkpoints
Grafana panels show committed vs float capacity and historical carryover projections
Automated link from scoreboard to Console roadmap with priority tags
Pilot retrospective with stakeholder approvals and improvement items captured

2026-03-10 - Priya Singh: Updated runbook draft with ripcord steps and added 'max 2-week borrow' rule per Eng feedback. PRD link and pilot checklist added. Ready for PM steering review.
rollout_notes: Pilot will run for two cycles. Post-pilot retro scheduled for 2026-04-08. If pilot meets acceptance criteria, we will fold runbook into the Cycle Planning toolkit and update templates in Console. Ops will add one Grafana alert (float < 6%).
notes: Trade-offs discussed: static float simplifies decisioning but can be suboptimal for bursts tied to external partner integrations. If pilot shows frequent under/over allocation, move to risk-indexed dynamic float and expand staffing simulator to include partner probability inputs.
